step_outcomes.description: Figure 4 cross-check: convert shipped quarterly UE/EU instantaneous rates to full-month probabilities Lambda=1-exp(-lambda), compare Lambda^UE vs two-state F and Lambda^EU vs two-state X on the overlapping quarterly sample; report correlations and mean log-level differences; emit two-panel Figure 4.
step_outcomes.notes: Overlap 1967Q2-2004Q4 (151 quarters). corr_F_UE=0.9474, mean_logdiff_F_UE=0.320 log pts (two-state F above Lambda^UE); corr_X_EU=0.8503, mean_logdiff_X_EU=0.586 log pts (two-state X above Lambda^EU). High correlations confirm the two-state and three-state measures move together, the consistency check the paper draws in Section 3 / Figure 7. Positive level gaps are expected: the two-state model attributes all unemployment exits to job finding and all employment exits to a single hazard, so its probabilities sit above the direct U->E and E->U three-state flows.
